scope: T4, one public JFK clip, one warmup and four alternating measured processes per engine. Crisp profiling off/on are the same source-built binary; fork is a separately packaged binary with different build and CUDA libraries. Process time includes startup and GPU monitoring. Do not attribute the difference to an individual cause without same-toolchain controls.
limits: Profiled loader phases are partial and do not account for all load time.
Decode compute includes scheduler synchronization and is host wall time.
Matching one clip is not general speed or recognition acceptance.

observed_build_differences.source_built_crisp: CUDA 12.8, architecture 750, VMM disabled because configure did not find libcuda; CUDA graphs enabled
observed_build_differences.packaged_fork: CUDA architectures 750, 800, 860 and 890; runtime reports VMM available
observed_build_differences.interpretation: Different builds and ggml/CUDA libraries prevent causal attribution. VMM is a hypothesis for controlled testing, not an established cause.
